Secret Rare.name: Exodia the Forbidden One
Secret Rare.desc: If you have "Right Leg of the Forbidden One", "Left Leg of the Forbidden One", "Right Arm of the Forbidden One" and "Left Arm of the Forbidden One" in addition to this card in your hand, you win the Duel.

Secret Rare.name: Left Arm of the Forbidden One

Secret Rare.name: Left Leg of the Forbidden One

Secret Rare.name: Right Arm of the Forbidden One

Secret Rare.name: Right Leg of the Forbidden One
